description:
Log in to Bahmni/OpenMRS with username 'superman' and password 'Admin123'. Navigate to the OpenMRS Administration interface (often accessible via 'Advanced Settings' or directly at /openmrs/admin). In the 'Orders' or 'Care Settings' section, create a new Care Setting with the following details:
- Name: 'Telemedicine'
- Description: 'Remote consultation service orders'
- Care Setting Type: 'Outpatient'

Save the new care setting so it is active in the system.
